# Great Learning

> > Great Learning offers online degree programs, professional certificates, and free courses in AI, data science, business analytics, and technology from universities like UT Austin, MIT, and Walsh College.

Great Learning partners with top universities including Walsh College, University of Texas at Austin, MIT, and IIT to deliver accredited degree programs (MS, DBA), postgraduate certificates, and free courses. The platform specializes in AI, machine learning, data analytics, and business education with career-focused learning paths.
